units: <cite ref="Gittin 69a:5">Gitt. 69ᵃ</cite> <he>ניגדול תרתי וכ׳</he> let him twine two threads.
<cite ref="Moed Katan 11a:2">M. Kat. 11ᵃ</cite> <he>למִיגְדַּל אהורי</he> to weave nets; <he>למי׳ תנורא</he> to build a stove, v. <cite ref="C00225">preced.</cite>

<cite ref="Chagigah 4b:11">Ḥag. 4ᵇ</cite> <he>מרים מְגַדְּלָא נשייא</he> Ms. M. (ed. <he>מג׳ שיער נ׳</he>) Miriam the women’s hair-dresser (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note); <cite ref="Sanhedrin 67a">Snh. 67ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Shabbat 104b">Sabb. 104ᵇ</cite> (missing in later editions).
<cite ref="Sukkah 37a:6">Succ. 37ᵃ</cite> <he>הנהו מְגַדְּלֵי הושענא</he> those twining the willow twigs (v. <cite ref="E00289"><he>הוֹשַׁעְנָא</he></cite>).
